name: mastermind-ad-engine
description: Create static ads people actually feel: billboards, posters, print, and social statics. A 7-step method (emotional truth, category flip, punchline, visual twist, micro-tribe, platform fit, taste test) with scoring tools, a 15-minute quickstart, a cold creative-director critique, A/B variants, a launch checklist, and rendered SVG mockups, including ads with people drawn as bold vector figures.
